subject: Investigation: Omniforge promo claim stacking and corrective action
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suspected promo stacking — Omniforge (account: omniforge.ai)

Team,

Alert from the promo engine: Omniforge has requested and received three separate trial top-ups within a 28-day window across two org IDs that map back to the same billing email domain. Pattern looks like: initial trial -> manual extension via sales promo -> automated extension via support voucher.

I pulled the token issuance logs and attached a CSV with the events (audit_log_export.csv). Key points:
- 2027-05-22: initial 10K eval credits issued (trial).
- 2027-06-01: sales-approved extension (Ben, I see you signed off in HubSpot?).
- 2027-06-15: automated promo applied via voucher code (voucher_xxx).

We should assess whether this is coordinated (multi-org) usage to game free credits or a legitimate multi-team pilot. Recommend: pause further promo issuance, flag related org IDs, and request a statement from the customer.

Ben — can you confirm what was documented in the contact record and whether a PO exists?

Attachments: audit_log_export.csv (CSV, 48KB)

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspected promo stacking — Omniforge (account: omniforge.ai)

Thanks Ben — good catch.

Please treat this as a hold on any manual credit approvals for Omniforge until we complete an internal review. Marissa, Naomi — can you review the audit CSV and advise whether this meets our "coordinated promo stacking" criteria? If yes, I'd like a recommended response that preserves the ability to escalate to billing/legal.

Ben — do not engage the customer directly on this yet other than to acknowledge receipt if they ask. I'll loop in CS/security if we need telemetry correlation.

Elliot
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel@omniforge.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Suspected promo stacking — Omniforge (account: omniforge.ai)

Elliot / Ben,

Thanks for the heads up. I think there's a misunderstanding — Omniforge is running multiple, independent product teams (ML infra / R&D / integrations) and each team requested an evaluation. We coordinated internally but did not intend to circumvent any limits. I've attached our Q2 PO for transparency.

From our side: we can consolidate into a single org if required, but that will take some admin time and could interrupt the pilots. Is there a short-term path to keep the current evals active while we clean up orgs?

Regards,
Daniel Park
Director of Integrations
Omniforge Inc.

Attachments: PO_omniforge_Q2.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspected promo stacking — Omniforge (account: omniforge.ai)

Elliot / Ben — I reviewed the audit CSV and the HubSpot record. Summary and recommendation below: 

Summary:
- Multiple trial credits were issued to two org IDs that show overlapping IP ranges and identical billing contact (daniel@omniforge.ai).
- Sales approved an extension on 2027-06-01 for Org A with a note referencing "product team pilot" but not a consolidated company pilot.
- A voucher was later applied for Org B on 2027-06-15 via a support flow.

Policy implications:
- Our promo policy (internal draft v1.3) prohibits otherwise-unjustified consecutive top-ups across distinct orgs when a single legal entity benefits without documented procurement.
- The PO helps, but it does not retroactively authorize stacked trial credits; PO indicates intent to purchase but not formal procurement that would replace promo credits.

Recommended action:
1) Temporarily disable further promo issuance for both org IDs and create a hold in billing.
2) Offer a remediation: consolidate into a single paid seat/commitment (we can provide a short-term discounted invoice to cover the pilots) within 10 business days, or we revoke outstanding promo credits and mark the accounts as ineligible for new promos for 90 days.
3) Provide a short, factual escalation response to the customer (see draft below).

Draft response (suggested):
-----
Elliot / Ben to Daniel:
Thanks for the PO and context. We reviewed the account activity and observed multiple trial credit issuances to related org IDs under the Omniforge umbrella without a consolidated procurement commitment. To keep the pilots running while you clean up org structure, we can offer a one-time short-term invoice at a discounted rate that will convert the open trial credits to paid usage for 30 days. Alternatively, if you'd prefer to consolidate into a single org, we can pause credits until consolidation is complete. Please let us know which path you prefer by 2027-06-29 to avoid automatic revocation.
-----

If you want, I can coordinate the billing invoice and prepare the compliance justification. Also recommend we capture the final decision in HubSpot and attach the audit CSV.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@omniforge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final decision: Omniforge promo credits — interim remediation

Daniel — thanks for the quick reply and the PO. We want to support your pilots but must enforce our promo policy consistently. After reviewing logs and consulting legal and billing, here is the interim resolution: 

1) We will place a 10-business-day remediation window (through 2027-06-29) during which you can either:
   - Consolidate the pilots into a single org and request conversion to a paid commitment (preferred), or
   - Accept a one-time discounted invoice that converts the outstanding promo credits into paid usage for 30 days.

2) If no election is made by 2027-06-29, we will revoke the additional promo credits applied on 2027-06-15 and suspend further promo eligibility for the related orgs for 90 days.

3) We have flagged the two org IDs in billing and logged this decision in HubSpot (link below). Our Billing team will issue the discounted invoice if you select that path; Marissa will coordinate.

Please reply to confirm which path you choose. If you need assistance consolidating orgs, Ben can introduce you to our onboarding specialist.

Attachment: decision_notice.txt (text) — contains the facts and policy citation for your records.

Elliot Price
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
